text.en: Find the notes of line 1: each one waits until you're on it.
text.es: Busca las notas de la frase 1: cada una te espera hasta que estés en ella.

text.en: In Burleigh's setting the altos sing the tune. The sopranos wait eight bars, then float the refrain above the altos' second time through, mostly on long notes. In the verse both sing the tune together, until the sopranos climb alone on "That promised land".
text.es: En el arreglo de Burleigh, las contraltos cantan la melodía. Las sopranos esperan ocho compases y luego hacen flotar el estribillo sobre la segunda vuelta de las contraltos, casi todo en notas largas. En la estrofa cantan juntas la melodía, hasta que las sopranos suben solas en "That promised land".

source.en: H. T. Burleigh, Deep River, for mixed voices (New York: G. Schirmer, 1914), pp. 1 to 3, read from the scan
source.es: H. T. Burleigh, Deep River, for mixed voices (New York: G. Schirmer, 1914), pp. 1 a 3, leído en el escaneo

text.en: Deep River was in print by 1875, in the second edition of J. B. T. Marsh's The Story of the Jubilee Singers; with Their Songs, a book about Fisk University's touring singers.
text.es: Deep River ya estaba impreso en 1875, en la segunda edición de The Story of the Jubilee Singers; with Their Songs, de J. B. T. Marsh, un libro sobre los cantantes de gira de la Universidad Fisk.

source.en: J. B. T. Marsh, The Story of the Jubilee Singers; with Their Songs, second edition (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1875), No. 77, pp. 196 to 197, Universitätsbibliothek Gießen, Gb 4660; and University of Pittsburgh, Voices Across Time, "Deep River"
